questions.question: Who among the following published a set of Ashokan inscriptions in the year 1877?
questions.solution:
• Year: 1877
  • Person: Alexander Cunningham published a collection of Ashokan inscriptions.

questions.question: Who among the following was the first Indian to win a seat in the House of Commons?
questions.solution:
• Person: Dadabhai Naoroji
  • Fact: The first Indian elected to the British House of Commons.

questions.question: In which of the following states are the Son Bhandar Caves located?
questions.solution:
• Location: Bihar
  • Site: Son Bhandar Caves are located in Rajgir.

questions.question: In which of the following years was the Asiatic Society at Calcutta (Kolkata) founded by Sir William Jones?
questions.solution:
• Year: 1784
  • Org: Asiatic Society at Calcutta was founded by Sir William Jones.

questions.question: Who among the following Sikh Gurus founded the Tarn Taran Sahib?
questions.solution:
• Guru: Guru Arjan Dev
  • Fact: The 5th Sikh Guru who founded Tarn Taran Sahib.

questions.question: Who was the first Director-General of Archaeological Survey of India?
questions.solution:
• Director: Alexander Cunningham
  • Org: First Director-General of the Archaeological Survey of India (ASI).

questions.question: At which of the following places did Lord Buddha attain enlightenment?
questions.solution:
• Site: Bodh Gaya
  • Fact: The place where Lord Buddha attained enlightenment.

questions.question: Muhammad Ghori attacked Tabarhinda (Bhatinda) in 1191, a strategic point for ______.
questions.solution:
• Ruler: Prithviraj Chauhan
  • Context: Tabarhinda was a strategic point for him before the battles with Ghori.

questions.question: One of the major events of Ashoka’s reign was the convening of the ______ Buddhist Sangha (council) in 250 BCE in the capital Pataliputra.
questions.solution:
• Council: Third
  • Fact: Emperor Ashoka convened the 3rd Buddhist Council in Pataliputra.

questions.question: According to Ashokan edicts, how many years after becoming the king did Ashoka wage war on Kalinga?
questions.solution:
• Time: Eight years
  • Event: Ashoka waged the Kalinga war 8 years after his coronation.

questions.question: Who among the following is the author of the book 'Tabaqat-i-Nasiri'?
questions.solution:
• Author: Minhaj-us-Siraj
  • Work: Author of Tabaqat-i-Nasiri, a history of the Islamic world.

questions.question: Prithviraj Chauhan and Muhammad Ghori fought the battle of ______.
questions.solution:
• Battle: Tarain
  • Fact: The series of battles fought between Prithviraj Chauhan and Muhammad Ghori.

questions.question: Who among the following was the first scholar to decipher the Ashokan edicts?
questions.solution:
• Person: James Prinsep
  • Fact: The first scholar to decipher the Brahmi script used in Ashokan edicts.

questions.question: Who among the following chroniclers wrote about Raziyya and recognised that she was more able and qualified than all her brothers?
questions.solution:
• Author: Minhaj-i-Siraj
  • Opinion: Chronicler who wrote that Raziyya was more able than her brothers.

questions.question: The Indian Mutiny began from Meerut on 10 May 1857 and ended in:
questions.solution:
• Date: 20 June 1858
  • Event: The 1857 Mutiny officially ended with the fall of Gwalior.

questions.question: Who among the following issued Mahjarnama in 1579?
questions.solution:
• Ruler: Akbar
  • Decree: Issued the Mahjarnama (Infallibility Decree) in 1579.

questions.question: Gautamiputra Satakarni was a ______ ruler.
questions.solution:
• Dynasty: Satavahana
  • Ruler: Gautamiputra Satakarni was the most powerful ruler of this dynasty.

questions.question: The Battle of Khanua was fought between Babur and ______.
questions.solution:
• Battle: Khanua (1527)
  • Opponents: Fought between Babur and Rana Sanga.

questions.question: Who among the following earned the sobriquet ‘Bharat Kokila’ from Mahatma Gandhi?
questions.solution:
• Person: Sarojini Naidu
  • Title: Known as 'Bharat Kokila' (Nightingale of India).

questions.question: Who among the following had invaded India in 712 AD?
questions.solution:
• Year: 712 AD
  • Invader: Muhammad Bin-Quasim led the first Arab invasion of Sindh.

questions.question: Prophet Muhammad founded the faith of Islam in the ______ century.
questions.solution:
• Century: Seventh
  • Event: Prophet Muhammad founded Islam in the 7th century.

questions.question: Which Sultan established a separate department (Diwan-i-Amir Kohi) to take care of agriculture?
questions.solution:
• Ruler: Muhammad Bin Tughlaq
  • Dept: Established Diwan-i-Amir Kohi for agricultural development.

questions.question: Who among the following is one of the founder members of Bhartiya Jana Sangh?
questions.solution:
• Founder: Shyama Prasad Mukherjee
  • Org: One of the founders of the Bhartiya Jana Sangh (1951).

questions.question: Swami Vivekananda championed the supremacy of Vedantic philosophy in the Chicago (The US) Conference of World Religions held in the year ______.
questions.solution:
• Year: 1893
  • Event: Swami Vivekananda delivered his famous speech in Chicago.

questions.question: Yashovigraha, Mahichandra and Chandradeva were the first three rulers of ______ dynasty.
questions.solution:
• Dynasty: Gahadavala
  • Rulers: Yashovigraha, Mahichandra, and Chandradeva were its first kings.

questions.question: Who founded the Vikramshila University and revived the Nalanda University?
questions.solution:
• Founder: Dharampala
  • Fact: Founded Vikramshila University and revived Nalanda.

questions.question: Ghiyas-ud-din Tughlaq was the governor of ______ during the reign of Ala-ud-din Khilji.
questions.solution:
• Region: Punjab
  • Fact: Ghiyas-ud-din Tughlaq was the Governor of Punjab under Khilji.

questions.question: In which of the following years did the Kakori Conspiracy case take place?
questions.solution:
• Year: 1925
  • Event: The Kakori Conspiracy case involving HRA revolutionaries.

questions.question: Who authored ‘Akbarnama’?
questions.solution:
• Author: Abul Fazl
  • Work: Author of the Akbarnama (The History of Akbar).
